connector.name: SendFast
connector.registryDescription: Agent-native marketing email: draft, edit, screenshot, and send from your verified domain.
connector.summary: Hosted at sendfast.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.sendfast, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your SendFast API key (sf_live_...). Get one at sendfast.ai/app/settings.
